description: IndustryDHFlex provides companion code for a study of industrial heat decarbonisation. The authors describe a linear investment-and-dispatch model coupling three industrial heat levels, a district-heating network, electricity and thermal storage through EnergyModelsX. The provider is Holmes, Till; Foslie, Sverre Stefanussen; Backe, Stian; Kauko, Hanne. Coverage: The reported application is a German region with five five-year investment periods. The metadata do not name the region or the first model year. Access: The depositor publishes the record and its file listing on Zenodo. Only metadata was read; the files were not downloaded. Licence and cost: The deposit states a MIT licence and public access. Any separately cited input data retain their own terms. Limitations: The description is a depositor statement, not independent verification of results or reusable software. File completeness and execution remain untested. For simulation it supports comparison of heat-exchange and storage options under tightening carbon constraints. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes covers pipe-network modelling. This thematic link does not establish use by the authors.
